import numpy as np

# Data for "Taxable Treasury bonds, due or callable - 20 years and after"
# Period: July 1953 through June 1956 (36 months)
# x = month number (1 = July 1953, 36 = June 1956)

yields = [
    # July 1953 - December 1953
    3.25,  # Jul 1953
    3.22,  # Aug 1953
    3.19,  # Sep 1953
    3.06,  # Oct 1953
    3.04,  # Nov 1953
    2.96,  # Dec 1953
    # January 1954 - December 1954
    2.90,  # Jan 1954
    2.85,  # Feb 1954
    2.73,  # Mar 1954
    2.70,  # Apr 1954
    2.72,  # May 1954
    2.70,  # Jun 1954
    2.62,  # Jul 1954
    2.60,  # Aug 1954
    2.64,  # Sep 1954
    2.65,  # Oct 1954
    2.68,  # Nov 1954
    2.68,  # Dec 1954
    # January 1955 - December 1955
    2.77,  # Jan 1955
    2.92,  # Feb 1955
    2.92,  # Mar 1955
    2.92,  # Apr 1955
    2.91,  # May 1955
    2.91,  # Jun 1955
    2.96,  # Jul 1955
    3.02,  # Aug 1955
    3.00,  # Sep 1955
    2.96,  # Oct 1955
    2.96,  # Nov 1955
    2.97,  # Dec 1955
    # January 1956 - June 1956
    2.94,  # Jan 1956
    2.93,  # Feb 1956
    2.98,  # Mar 1956
    3.10,  # Apr 1956
    3.03,  # May 1956
    2.98,  # Jun 1956
]

print(f"Number of data points: {len(yields)}")

# Create time index (July 1953 = 1, ..., June 1956 = 36)
x = np.array(range(1, len(yields) + 1))
y = np.array(yields)

# OLS Regression: y = beta0 + beta1*x
# Using normal equations
x_mean = np.mean(x)
y_mean = np.mean(y)

# Calculate slopes and intercept
beta1 = np.sum((x - x_mean) * (y - y_mean)) / np.sum((x - x_mean) ** 2)
beta0 = y_mean - beta1 * x_mean

print(f"\nOLS Regression Results:")
print(f"Intercept (beta0): {beta0}")
print(f"Slope (beta1): {beta1}")
print(f"Equation: y = {beta0:.6f} + {beta1:.6f} * x")

# Predict for July 1956 (x = 37)
x_forecast = 37
y_forecast = beta0 + beta1 * x_forecast

print(f"\nForecast for July 1956 (month {x_forecast}):")
print(f"Yield: {y_forecast:.6f}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(y_forecast, 3)}")

# Also calculate R-squared
y_pred = beta0 + beta1 * x
ss_res = np.sum((y - y_pred) ** 2)
ss_tot = np.sum((y - y_mean) ** 2)
r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
print(f"\nR-squared: {r_squared:.6f}")
